quickAnswerTitle: How Hawaii Public School Calendars Work
quickAnswer: Hawaii operates one statewide public-school system through the Hawaii State Department of Education. Most public schools use the statewide HIDOE calendar, while Holomua Elementary follows a separate multitrack calendar and charter schools publish their own calendars.
footerNote: Calendar coverage and source links are checked against the Hawaii State Department of Education. Always use the calendar published for your child’s school.
about:
Hawaii’s public-school calendar system differs from states with many local districts. HIDOE manages one statewide calendar for most public schools, so families generally start with the state calendar rather than searching for separate Honolulu, Maui, Hawaii Island, or Kauai district dates.

This page explains that system and directs families to the detailed HIDOE resource. The full district page contains exact dates, breaks, official PDFs, the HIDOE Google Calendar, ICS downloads, source history, and school-year-specific notes.

faqs.q: Why does Hawaii use one statewide public-school calendar?
faqs.a: Hawaii operates a single statewide public-school system through HIDOE rather than separate county school districts. Most public schools therefore use one statewide calendar.

faqs.q: Does the statewide HIDOE calendar apply to every public school?
faqs.a: No. Holomua Elementary follows a separate multitrack calendar, and charter schools publish their own calendars. School-level events may also require a campus calendar or announcement.

faqs.q: Where can I find the complete HIDOE dates and downloads?
faqs.a: Open the full Hawaii State Department of Education calendar resource on this page. It provides school-year-specific dates, official PDFs, the HIDOE Google Calendar, ICS downloads, and review notes.
